description: Bash permissions the lt CLI copies verbatim into the user settings for auto-approval; it only appends, so a rule removed here stays in existing settings until removed by hand. A trailing ':*' equals a trailing ' *' and is recognised only at the end of a pattern; a colon anywhere else, escaped or not, is a literal character. Settings rules do not expand ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}, so a rule that contains it matches only with the placeholder replaced by the absolute plugin install path. Every rule applies in every project, so a pattern names the narrow command its description states; broad tools (curl, node, docker run, git push) are granted per turn through a command's allowed-tools instead.
